'''Bruce McBrain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. After one of Jabba's minions betrayed him, so as to lessen a sentence, McBrain hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to locate and destroy the minion's [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] en route to a council of Galactic Judges. After the spacer completed this task, the McBrain gave him an [[AV-21 Landspeeder|AV-21 landspeeder]].
